title: Execute sub-stories individually or in sequence
userStory: As a developer, I want to execute stories one at a time or batch them so that I control the execution pace.
acceptanceCriteria: Individual 'Execute' button on each Ready story
'Execute Next' on parent runs next unblocked story (user must click)
'Execute All Ready' batch option on parent (with confirmation)
Parallel execution option for independent stories (with explicit user opt-in)
User can pause batch execution between stories
